verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents concrete REST endpoints for OneDrive files — driveItem addressing (drive/items/{id}, path-based), upload sessions and put-content for uploads, search/delta/list-versions/list-thumbnails for listing and change tracking — clearly showing a real programmatic files API beyond the desktop client. However the evidence pack never explicitly cites move or delete endpoints (e.g., PATCH parentReference or DELETE driveItem), leaving two of the five named operations unevidenced; community citations are all about desktop sync behavior and are irrelevant to the API story. Missing for 10: explicit move endpoint documentation, explicit delete endpoint documentation, and independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the full CRUD flow.
